acceptance_criteria: Moves into the vault never overwrite: an identical attachment is kept and survives a refused apply, a different one keeps both files and protects the set, and one written during the apply refuses it. A folder named by the checkpoint or an open bug keeps the loose files and observation sets inside it. A loose folder with any current file stays whole. The new tests fail first, fledge lanes run verify passes on Linux, and the trim reruns on this repository at closeout.
